question: Calculate the average pick percentage for each product name, using a first-in-first-out approach that selects from inventory locations based on the earliest purchase date and smallest available quantity, ensuring that the picked quantity reflects only the overlapping range between each order’s required quantity and the inventory’s available quantity, and then grouping and ordering the results by product name?

prediction.sql:
WITH inv_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    i.product_id,
    i.qty AS inv_qty,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY i.product_id
      ORDER BY p.purchased ASC, i.qty ASC
    ) AS inv_rn
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN purchases p ON p.id = i.purchase_id
),
ord_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    ol.product_id,
    ol.qty AS order_qty,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY ol.product_id
      ORDER BY ol.id ASC
    ) AS ord_rn
  FROM orderlines ol
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT
    o.product_id,
    o.order_qty,
    i.inv_qty,
    MIN(o.order_qty, i.inv_qty) AS picked_qty
  FROM ord_ranked o
  JOIN inv_ranked i
    ON i.product_id = o.product_id
   AND i.inv_rn = o.ord_rn
)
SELECT
  pr.name AS product_name,
  AVG(p.picked_qty * 1.0 / p.order_qty) AS avg_pick_pct
FROM pairs p
JOIN products pr ON pr.id = p.product_id
GROUP BY pr.name
ORDER BY pr.name;

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT i.product_id, i.qty,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty) rn
  FROM inventory i JOIN purchases p ON p.id = i.purchase_id
),
ord AS (
  SELECT ol.product_id, ol.qty,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ol.product_id ORDER BY ol.id) rn
  FROM orderlines ol
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT o.product_id, o.qty AS order_qty, i.qty AS inv_qty
  FROM ord o JOIN inv i ON i.product_id = o.product_id AND i.rn = o.rn
)
SELECT pr.name AS product_name,
       AVG(MIN(p.order_qty, p.inv_qty) * 1.0 / p.order_qty) AS avg_pick_pct
FROM pairs p JOIN products pr ON pr.id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, pr.name
ORDER BY pr.name;

persistent_recovery_advisory_draft.base_sql:
SELECT p.name,
       AVG(MIN(ol.qty, i.qty) / ol.qty) AS avg_pick_pct
FROM orderlines ol
JOIN inventory i
  ON i.product_id = ol.product_id
JOIN purchases pu
  ON pu.id = i.purchase_id
JOIN products p
  ON p.id = ol.product_id
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY p.name;
